answer: Resist sybils by requiring each identity to lock a deposit and complete unique graded work over several epochs before unlock. A similarity engine rejects near-copies, so an attacker cannot reuse one sonnet across many wallets. Intake is capped, so a sudden delta in sign-ups still pays the same bond and delay. A sponsor must also escrow stake, a willow of shared liability: a later cluster proof slashes newcomer and sponsor together. Farm cost is N bonds plus burned sponsor capital, not free sign-ups.
